channel.title: Boulder Daily Camera - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder Daily Camera (dailycamera.com)

item.title: Memo says White House was ‘excellently preserved’ during East Wing demolition for Trump’s ballroom
item.description: The memo says the new ballroom includes a larger visitor screening center.

item.title: Affordable housing residents near Portland ICE building ask judge to limit feds’ use of tear gas
item.description: The complex's property manager and multiple residents filed a lawsuit after months of repeated exposure.

item.title: Some US schools cancel class pictures after online claims surrounding Epstein
item.description: Photography giant Lifetouch called the claims “completely false.”

item.title: Judge dismisses charges against 3 Connecticut officers accused of mistreating paralyzed prisoner
item.description: The officers were accused of mistreating a prisoner after he was paralyzed in a police van.

item.title: A California photographer is on a quest to photograph hundreds of native bees
item.description: Krystle Hickman has photographed over 300 types of bees native to North America.

item.title: Immigration officials plan to spend $38.3 billion to boost detention capacity to 92,000 beds
item.description: ICE plans 16 regional processing centers with a population of 1,000 to 1,500 detainees.

item.title: Illumina completes acquisition of SomaLogic from Standard BioTools
item.description: Illumina Inc. (Nasdaq: ILMN), a genomics and molecular diagnostics company headquartered in San Diego, closed in late January on its acquisition of Boulder-based biotech firm SomaLogic Inc.

item.title: University of Colorado paying $2M for student ChatGPT access
item.description: The University of Colorado system, which includes campuses in Boulder, Colorado Springs, Denver and the Anschutz medical campus in Aurora, is paying $2 million for one year of access to OpenAI’s ChatGPT Edu artificial intelligence platform.

item.title: Broomfield girls swimming wins Class 4A state championship
item.description: Long before Broomfield girls swimming first jumped into the water for the 2025-26 season, head coach Emily Austin predicted the Eagles would win the Class 4A state championship.
